sections.Profile:
The "Can Can" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in August 1955, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. This machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, one gobble hole, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Backbox Gimmick, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
